note: PROTOTYPE — the logging viewer's own key bindings, as data (architecture.md §5): change a key here, not in code. The player keys — Space, ← →, J K L — are every player's and live in @workspace/shared/navigation, so they cannot drift between players. Shift is read by the action itself: Shift+I/O marks the exact playhead, Shift+Tab selects the previous brick, Shift+Esc redoes. In the brick editor (P), I/O set an edge at the playhead, [ ] step the in point and , . the out point by word, a frame with Shift. Revised from David's feedback, 2026-10-29.
